checkpoints.description: [1/2] Read answers.jsonl once with a buffered line scan instead of readline streaming: 4.64ms -> 3.59ms per 10k rows

impact_assessment.why: User directive to keep improving speeds; /api/tune/runs/:id re-parses every answer line through readline at 4.64ms for 10k rows
impact_assessment.benefits: Buffered line scan is ~23% faster on the on-demand run-summary route and the tests that summarize answers
impact_assessment.risks: contract: summary values and malformed-line handling unchanged including CRLF; dependency: Node fs only; concurrency: none; state: app-written bounded answers file read fully like cachedAnswers already does
impact_assessment.mitigation: equivalence test over CRLF, truncated final line and unreadable examples, full npm test and strict gates; revert if regression

checkpoints.description: [2/2] DELIVERED: run summary 3.14ms -> 2.48ms (1.26x) in 7-round A/B; 1130 tests pass
[1/2] Cache the sorted public model list and invalidate it when entries change: 20us -> ~0.2us per listPublic() call on a 60-model library

impact_assessment.why: User directive to keep improving speeds; /api/state and the 15+ listPublic callers rebuild and re-sort the same public model list on every poll
impact_assessment.benefits: Repeated listPublic reads become a slice of a cached array while scan/delete still invalidate exactly
impact_assessment.risks: contract: returned rows and ordering unchanged; dependency: Node only; concurrency: none; state: cache keyed on entries identity, invalidated on scan reassignment and delete
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test plus caller-tamper and delete-invalidation checks, full npm test and strict gates; revert if regression

checkpoints.description: [2/2] DELIVERED: listPublic 21.37us -> 0.083us (258x) in same-process A/B; 1132 tests pass
[1/2] Probe the cached profile list in /api/tune/overview before loadProfile: 4.88ms -> sub-ms on a 60-model library

impact_assessment.why: User directive to keep improving speeds; /api/tune/overview calls loadProfile+profileFingerprint 60 times even with zero saved profiles
impact_assessment.benefits: One cached listProfiles read replaces 60 failing profile stats on an unprofiled library
impact_assessment.risks: contract: response shape and values unchanged; dependency: existing listProfiles/loadProfile; concurrency: none; state: a profile created mid-request is visible on the next poll
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first test with read counter and a saved-profile parity check, full npm test and strict gates; revert if regression

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Read answers.jsonl once in itemOutcomes instead of readline streaming: 12.52ms per 20k rows

impact_assessment.why: User directive to keep improving speeds; itemOutcomes is the last large JSONL reader still using readline at 12.52ms for 20k rows
impact_assessment.benefits: Saturating-item analysis for tune restore becomes faster with identical counts
impact_assessment.risks: contract: saturated set and per-item counts unchanged including malformed/error rows; dependency: Node fs only; concurrency: none; state: app-written bounded answers files read one at a time
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first equivalence test with CRLF, malformed and error rows, full npm test and strict gates; revert if regression

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Memoize the judge cache key by argument identity: 9.37us -> ~0.1us per repeated cache hit

impact_assessment.why: User directive to keep improving speeds; every runJavaScriptTests cache hit re-stringified the whole 40-case check to build its key
impact_assessment.benefits: Repeated identical (text, check, timeout) judge calls skip key construction while logical dedup stays exact
impact_assessment.risks: contract: judge verdicts and cache keys unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: identity-only memo, so a mutated check still gets a fresh key
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test plus verdict parity, full npm test and strict gates; revert if regression

checkpoints.description: [2/2] DELIVERED: judge cache key 4.80us -> 0.78us (6.2x); rescan flake fixed; 1138 tests pass
[1/2] Aggregate multistep chain results in one pass instead of O(runs x depth) rescans: 160us -> ~30us for 1000x5

impact_assessment.why: User directive to keep improving speeds; summarizeChains rescans the whole results array once per step depth
impact_assessment.benefits: Multistep report aggregation becomes linear with identical summary values including sparse depth and error counts
impact_assessment.risks: contract: every returned field identical including sparse byStep slots and rates; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: pure function
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first equivalence test over irregular step counts, errors and rates, full npm test and strict gates; revert if regression
